findings.documented: Append API key as a query parameter: ?api_key=...
findings.actual: API key must be sent in the X-API-Key request header.
findings.how_found: Got a 401 Unauthorized with detail: 'send your key in the X-API-Key request header, not as a query parameter'.
findings.impact: Requests sending only query params fail immediately; frontend api client was updated to send X-API-Key header on all requests.

findings.documented: Returns { "token": "...", "expires_in": 86400 } with 24-hour validity and no refresh flow.
findings.actual: Returns access_token, refresh_token, and expires_in is 900 (15 minutes).
findings.how_found: Inspected login response payload and observed access_token with short 900s expiry.
findings.impact: Frontend must implement token refresh before 15 minutes to keep sessions alive without logging out the user.

findings.actual: Pagination uses offset instead of page and strictly caps limit at 50.
findings.how_found: Requesting limit=100 returned only 50 records and page parameter did not offset results properly.
findings.impact: Frontend pagination helper must use offset increments of 50 to iterate through all pages correctly.

findings.documented: Returns active sale listings... Inactive, expired and withdrawn listings are excluded server side.
findings.actual: Endpoint returns records where is_live is false.
findings.how_found: Found 708 listings with is_live=false across the complete dataset.
findings.impact: Frontend and analytics must explicitly filter by is_live when displaying active inventory.

findings.documented: Money: Indian rupees, integer, everywhere in the API.
findings.actual: price_min and price_max are decimal Floats representing Crores, not integer Rupees.
findings.how_found: Inspected raw project responses where price_max was 4.54 instead of 45400000.
findings.impact: Frontend project cards and detail views must format decimal Crores correctly without dividing by 10^7 twice.

findings.actual: Endpoint returns 404 Not Found and is not implemented on the server.
findings.how_found: Calling GET /v1/favourites and POST /v1/favourites produced 404 responses.
findings.impact: Frontend uses user-scoped local storage to persist favourites across reloads and re-logins.

findings.actual: The endpoint is plural: /v1/listings/{id}. Using the singular path returns 404 Not Found.
findings.how_found: Direct calls to /v1/listing/{id} returned 404; testing /v1/listings/{id} succeeded.
findings.impact: Detail view routes and fetch calls must use the plural /v1/listings/{id} path.

findings.documented: Every listing_id is globally unique, and each listing corresponds to exactly one physical property.
findings.actual: Multiple listing records describe the identical physical property with identical location, floor, area, and bedrooms.
findings.how_found: Grouped listings by physical attributes and detected duplicates in the retrievable dataset.
findings.impact: Deduplication is required when computing exact physical property counts.

findings.actual: Certain listing records contain physically impossible values (e.g., floor greater than total_floors or impossible coordinates/dimensions).
findings.how_found: Queried listings with floor > total_floors and impossible specs to identify corrupt IDs.
findings.impact: Frontend and metrics calculations must exclude corrupt records from averages.

findings.documented: All retrievable listings represent authentic properties.
findings.actual: Several fake listings exist in the dataset to generate false enquiries.
findings.how_found: Analyzed suspicious contact patterns, description heuristics, and duplicate templates.
findings.impact: Excluded fake listings when calculating reliable market price benchmarks.
